token、产品密钥和 OTA 私钥不得出现在 UI、日志、串口输出或 MQTT payload 中。命令和数据格式继续以 [NSH 协议](docs/velaguard-host-nsh-protocol.md) 为准，不在各任务重复维护命令表。 ### 硬件资料要求 - Windows 官方资料包：`F:\Project\Embeded\H750B-DK\BOARD #
# 用法（命令用分号分隔；-File 不会把逗号分隔的参数拆成数组）：
#   powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/serial_cmd.ps1 `
#     -Commands "vgagent status;vgagent ask hello;vgagent status"
param(
  [string]$ComPort = "COM3",
  [string]$Commands = "",
  [int]$BootSec = 12,
  [int]$PerCmdSec = 20
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# The board prints UTF-8. PowerShell decodes it correctly, but writes the result
# back out using the console code page (CP936 on this machine), so a redirected
# log ends up GBK and the Chinese comes out garbled. Pin stdout to UTF-8 so
# captured evidence matches what the board actually sent.
try { [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch { }

if ($Commands.Trim() -eq "") { throw "需要至少一条 -Commands" }

$cmdList = $Commands.Split(";") | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne "" }

$port = New-Object System.IO.Ports.SerialPort $ComPort, 115200
$port.Encoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
$port.ReadTimeout = 8000
$port.DtrEnable = $true
$port.RtsEnable = $true
$port.Open()

function Drain([int]$sec) {
  $b = ""
  $dl = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($sec)
  while ((Get-Date) -lt $dl) {
    if ($port.BytesToRead -gt 0) { $b += $port.ReadExisting() }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
  }
  return $b
}

$settle = Drain $BootSec
Write-Host "########## boot settle len=$($settle.Length) ##########"
Write-Host $settle

foreach ($c in $cmdList) {
  $port.DiscardInBuffer()
  $port.Write("$c`r")
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400
  $b = Drain $PerCmdSec
  Write-Host "`n########## $c ########## len=$($b.Length)"
  Write-Host $b
}

$port.Close()

﻿# USER1 按住说话事件验收（BVO-02）。
#
# 串口脚本不能模拟人手按键，所以分两段：

#     -Case normal -Count 30
#
# -Case 说明：
#   normal  普通按放：每次按住约 1 秒后松手。期望 begins/submits 各 +N。
#   bounce  快速连点：按几下短促点击，期望仍只增加 N 个会话。
#   long    长按：按住不放超过 15 秒再松手，期望 submits 中 timeouts +N，
#           且松手不再追加提交。
#   idle    只观察：不按键，确认空闲时 samples/events 不增长。
#
# 结果写 logs 并打印 PASS/FAIL 判定行。

param(
  [string]$ComPort = "COM3",
  [ValidateSet("normal", "bounce", "long", "idle")]
  [string]$Case = "normal",
  [int]$Count = 1,
  [int]$WindowSec = 12,
  [string]$Log = ""
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
try { [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch { }

$cap = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$port = New-Object System.IO.Ports.SerialPort $ComPort, 115200
$port.Encoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
$port.ReadTimeout = 8000
$port.DtrEnable = $true
$port.RtsEnable = $true
$port.Open()

function Drain([int]$sec) {
  $dl = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($sec)
  $acc = ""
  while ((Get-Date) -lt $dl) {
    if ($port.BytesToRead -gt 0) {
      $c = $port.ReadExisting()
      Write-Host -NoNewline $c
      $cap.Add($c)
      $acc += $c
    }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
  }
  return $acc
}

function SendText([string]$cmd, [int]$sec) {
  $port.DiscardInBuffer()
  $port.Write("$cmd`r")
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400
  $out = Drain $sec
  return $out
}

# 从 "vgptt: begins=A submits=B timeouts=C last_ms=D" 摘出计数
function ParseStats([string]$text) {
  $m = [regex]::Match($text, 'begins=(\d+) submits=(\d+) timeouts=(\d+) last_ms=(\d+)')
  if (-not $m.Success) { return $null }
  return [pscustomobject]@{
    Begins   = [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
    Submits  = [int]$m.Groups[2].Value
    Timeouts = [int]$m.Groups[3].Value
    LastMs   = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
  }
}

function ParseDetail([string]$text) {
  $m = [regex]::Match($text, 'samples=(\d+) events=(\d+) timeouts_wake=(\d+) poll_err=(\d+) read_err=(\d+)')
  if (-not $m.Success) { return $null }
  return [pscustomobject]@{
    Samples   = [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
    Events    = [int]$m.Groups[2].Value
